name: Runway
summary: AI creative-tools platform with an editorial film-festival aesthetic — cinematic dark heroes, paper-white reading bands, single proprietary sans, and pure black pill CTAs.

colors.name: Runway Black
colors.role: The primary page background and maximum-emphasis text.

colors.name: Deep Black
colors.role: A near-imperceptible variant for layered dark surfaces.

colors.name: Dark Surface
colors.role: Card backgrounds and elevated dark containers.

colors.name: Pure White
colors.role: Primary text on dark surfaces and light-section backgrounds.

colors.name: Near White
colors.role: The lightest surface — barely distinguishable from pure white.

colors.name: Cool Cloud
colors.role: Light section backgrounds with a cool blue-gray tint.

colors.name: Border Dark
colors.role: The single dark-mode border color — barely visible containment.

colors.name: Charcoal
colors.role: Primary body text on light surfaces and secondary text.

colors.name: Near Charcoal
colors.role: Slightly lighter variant for dark-section secondary text.

colors.name: Cool Slate
colors.role: Secondary body text — a distinctly blue-gray cool neutral.

colors.name: Tailwind Gray
colors.role: Standard Tailwind neutral for supplementary text.

colors.name: Footer Gray
colors.role: Footer links and deeply muted content.
